explanation: The executed affiliate amendment (effective Oct 15, 2025) set Marrow Agrisupply to Tier 1 (40 seats), and the May 1, 2026 shared renewal preserved MAS seats/SLA, with the September page still showing Tier 1. The May 11 weekly claiming Tier 2 like the parent is not backed by any executed reversion.
